BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain Storage-Propositional)
(:requirements :typing)

(:types
	place area - object
	depot container - place
	storearea transitarea - area
	hoist crate - object
)

(:predicates
	(clear ?a - storearea)
	(available ?h - hoist)
	(at ?h - hoist ?a - area)
	(lifting ?h - hoist ?c - crate)
	(on ?c - crate ?s - storearea)
	(in ?x - object ?p - place)
	(connected ?a1 - area ?a2 - area)
)

(:action lift
	:parameters (?h - hoist ?c - crate ?s - storearea ?a - area ?p - place)
	:precondition (and
		(available ?h)
		(at ?h ?a)
		(on ?c ?s)
		(in ?s ?p)
		(connected ?s ?a))
	:effect (and
		(not (on ?c ?s))
		(clear ?s)
		(not (available ?h))
		(lifting ?h ?c)
		(not (in ?c ?p)))
)

(:action drop
	:parameters (?h - hoist ?c - crate ?s - storearea ?a - area ?p - place)
	:precondition (and
		(at ?h ?a)
		(lifting ?h ?c)
		(clear ?s)
		(in ?s ?p)
		(connected ?a ?s))
	:effect (and
		(not (lifting ?h ?c))
		(available ?h)
		(not (clear ?s))
		(on ?c ?s)
		(in ?c ?p))
)

(:action move
	:parameters (?h - hoist ?from - storearea ?to - storearea)
	:precondition (and
		(at ?h ?from)
		(clear ?to)
		(connected ?from ?to))
	:effect (and
		(not (at ?h ?from))
		(at ?h ?to)
		(clear ?from)
		(not (clear ?to)))
)

(:action go-out
	:parameters (?h - hoist ?from - storearea ?to - transitarea)
	:precondition (and
		(at ?h ?from)
		(connected ?from ?to))
	:effect (and
		(not (at ?h ?from))
		(at ?h ?to)
		(clear ?from))
)

(:action go-in
	:parameters (?h - hoist ?from - transitarea ?to - storearea)
	:precondition (and
		(at ?h ?from)
		(connected ?from ?to)
		(clear ?to))
	:effect (and
		(not (at ?h ?from))
		(at ?h ?to)
		(not (clear ?to)))
)

)
END DOMAIN

Since this simple problem uses a single hoist and depot with no move actions, clear predicates aren't needed in the initial state at all—they're just unused here even though the domain supports them. For the lift action, removing a crate should make the source area clear again, and drop should make the destination occupied (not clear)—that logic holds up. For move, the logically consistent version adds clear to the source and removes clear from the destination, even though this seems to contradict the literal wording in the description; I suspect the description swapped source/destination or used "occupied" loosely to mean "not clear," so I'll go with the version that's internally consistent and matches the canonical domain rather than following the description literally where it conflicts.

Now I'm defining go-out (hoist moves from a storearea to a transitarea, clearing the storearea) and go-in (hoist moves from transitarea into a storearea, requiring it be clear and marking it not clear afterward). With these actions specified, I'm ready to assemble the complete domain file, making sure all types—storearea, hoist, crate, container, depot, transitarea, plus abstract supertypes place and area—line up exactly with what the problem file expects.
